prompt.project_info: Create a two-frame flash-lit editorial diptych of an approved adult woman lying on a beige carpet in a deep blue satin halter dress.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long dark hair fanned loosely around her head, relaxed smile in the sharp frame and playful motion in the second. She wears a deep-blue satin halter dress with realistic glossy folds, small earrings, delicate necklace, rings, and manicured nails. One hand touches the neckline near the collarbone while the other rests across the torso.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical diptych with two stacked frames and thin separation: frame one tack sharp with eyes closed and relaxed smile; frame two has intentional head-turn motion blur while the silhouette remains readable. Same beige carpet, top-down camera, outfit, and hair continuity.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera flash from above with minimal ambient light, medium-high contrast, controlled satin highlights, warm skin, spontaneous late-night candid energy, modern nightlife editorial realism.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 vertical, compact camera or smartphone, 24-28mm equivalent, f/1.8, faster shutter in frame one and slightly slower shutter in frame two, fine digital grain, no date stamp or text overlay.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical 3:4 editorial diptych of an approved adult woman lying on a neutral beige carpet in a deep-blue satin halter dress. Use two stacked frames with a thin border: frame one is tack sharp with eyes closed, a relaxed smile, dark hair spread around the head, and one hand touching the neckline; frame two shows a playful head turn with intentional motion blur, readable silhouette, and softly blurred hand. Keep the same outfit, floor, top-down 24-28mm camera position, small earrings, delicate necklace, rings, and manicured nails across frames. Use direct on-camera flash from above, minimal ambient light, medium-high contrast, controlled satin highlights, warm skin, fine digital grain, and no date stamp, watermark, or text overlay.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, date stamp, text, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped anatomy, distorted face, inconsistent outfit
